requirements.quote: This test method shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply and limit conducted transients from ESAs to the vehicle power supply.

requirements.text: The test method shall limit conducted transients from ESAs to the vehicle power supply.
requirements.quote: This test method shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply and limit conducted transients from ESAs to the vehicle power supply.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.quote: Apply the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines, except that ESAs exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to the starting profile.
requirements.quote: Apply the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines. ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to starting profile.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by ESAs on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as on other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.quote: Measurement according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height of less than 425 mm, the requirements of paragraph 4.1.1. shall be applied to the legform test to bumper.
requirements.quote: For vehicles with a lower bumper height of less than 425 mm the requirements of paragraph 4.1.1. shall be applied.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height which is greater than, or equal to 425 mm and less than 500 mm, the requirements of either paragraph 4.1.1. or 4.1.2., at the choice of the manufacturer, shall be applied to the legform test to bumper.
requirements.quote: For vehicles with a lower bumper height which is greater than, or equal to 425 mm and less than 500 mm the requirements of either paragraph 4.1.1. or 4.1.2., at the choice of the manufacturer, shall be applied.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height of greater than, or equal to, 500 mm, the requirements of paragraph 4.1.2. shall be applied to the legform test to bumper.
requirements.quote: For vehicles with a lower bumper height of greater than, or equal to, 500 mm the requirements of paragraph 4.1.2. shall be applied.

requirements.text: To verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.1. for the lower legform to bumper test, the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.1. shall be used.
requirements.quote: To verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.1., both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.1. and the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.1. shall be used.

requirements.text: To verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.1. for the lower legform to bumper test, the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.1. shall be used.
requirements.quote: To verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.1., both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.1. and the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.1. shall be used.

requirements.text: To verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.2. for the upper legform to bumper test, the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.2. shall be used.
requirements.quote: To verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.2., both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.2. and the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.2. shall be used.

requirements.text: To verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.2. for the upper legform to bumper test, the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.2. shall be used.
requirements.quote: To verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.2., both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.2. and the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.2. shall be used.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee of the front bumper shall not exceed 22 mm.
requirements.quote: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm, and the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament elongation shall not exceed 13 mm.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament elongation of the front bumper shall not exceed 13 mm.
requirements.quote: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm, and the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament elongation shall not exceed 13 mm.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the absolute value of dynamic bending moments at the tibia shall not exceed 340 Nm.
requirements.quote: The absolute value of dynamic bending moments at the tibia shall not exceed 340 Nm.

requirements.text: Where the manufacturer nominates bumper test widths up to a maximum of 264 mm in total, the absolute value of the tibia bending moment shall not exceed 380 Nm.
requirements.quote: In addition, the manufacturer may nominate bumper test widths up to a maximum of 264 mm in total where the absolute value of the tibia bending moment shall not exceed 380 Nm.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.2. (upper legform to bumper), the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN.
requirements.quote: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.2. (upper legform to bumper), the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN and the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.2. (upper legform to bumper), the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm.
requirements.quote: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.2. (upper legform to bumper), the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN and the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm.

requirements.text: At the time of testing, the test facility and the vehicle or sub-system shall have a relative humidity of 40 percent ± 30 percent.
requirements.quote: At the time of testing, the test facility and the vehicle or sub-system shall have a relative humidity of 40 percent \u00b1 30 percent and stabilized temperature of 20 + 4 \u00baC.

requirements.text: At the time of testing, the test facility and the vehicle or sub-system shall have a stabilized temperature of 20 + 4 ºC.
requirements.quote: At the time of testing, the test facility and the vehicle or sub-system shall have a relative humidity of 40 percent \u00b1 30 percent and stabilized temperature of 20 + 4 \u00baC.

requirements.text: Either a complete vehicle, or a cut-body, adjusted to the following conditions shall be used for the test.
requirements.quote: Either a complete vehicle, or a cut-body, adjusted to the following conditions shall be used for the test.

requirements.text: When a cut-body is used for the test, the cut-body shall include, in the test, all parts of the vehicle front structure, all under-bonnet components and all components behind the windscreen that may be involved in a frontal impact with a vulnerable road user, to demonstrate the performance and interactions of all the contributory vehicle components.
requirements.quote: The cut-body shall include, in the test, all parts of the vehicle front structure, all under-bonnet components and all components behind the windscreen that may be involved in a frontal impact with a vulnerable road user, to demonstrate the performance and interactions of all the contributory vehicle components.

requirements.text: When a cut-body is used for the test, the cut-body shall be securely mounted in the normal vehicle ride attitude.
requirements.quote: The cut-body shall be securely mounted in the normal vehicle ride attitude.

requirements.text: For vehicle components which could change shape or position, other than active devices to protect pedestrians, and which have more than one fixed shape or position, the vehicle shall comply with the requirements with the components in each fixed shape or position.
requirements.quote: For vehicle components which could change shape or position, other than active devices to protect pedestrians, and which have more than one fixed shape or position shall require the vehicle to comply with the components in each fixed shape or position.

requirements.text: In the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test procedure, each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.
requirements.quote: Flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test procedure: Each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.

requirements.text: In the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test procedure, the selected target points shall be in the bumper test area.
requirements.quote: The selected target points shall be in the bumper test area.

requirements.text: In the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test procedure, the impact velocity of the impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.quote: The impact velocity of the impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 \u00b1 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: In the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test procedure, the effect of gravity shall be taken into account when the impact velocity is obtained from measurements taken before the time of first contact.
requirements.quote: The effect of gravity shall be taken into account when the impact velocity is obtained from measurements taken before the time of first contact.

requirements.text: In the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test procedure, the tibia bending moments shall not exceed ± 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.
requirements.quote: The tibia bending moments shall not exceed \u00b1 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.

requirements.text: In the upper legform to bumper test procedure, each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.
requirements.quote: Upper legform to bumper test procedure: Each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.

requirements.text: The selected target points for the upper legform to bumper test procedure shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 3.10.
requirements.quote: The selected target points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 3.10.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the front bumper shall be 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.quote: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 \u00b1 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: The external surface of the front bumper shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.
requirements.quote: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.

requirements.text: The external surface of the front bumper shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.
requirements.quote: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.

requirements.text: No protruding part of the external surface of the front bumper shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm, except that this requirement shall not apply to parts of the external surface which protrude less than 5 mm.
requirements.quote: No protruding part of the external surface shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm. This requirement shall not apply to parts of the external surface which protrude less than 5 mm, but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.

requirements.text: The outward facing angles of parts of the external surface of the front bumper which protrude less than 5 mm shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
requirements.quote: This requirement shall not apply to parts of the external surface which protrude less than 5 mm, but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.

requirements.text: The hardness measurement of protruding parts of the external surface made of a material of hardness not exceeding 60 shore A shall be taken with the component as installed on the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The hardness measurement shall be taken with the component as installed on the vehicle.

requirements.text: Where it is impossible to carry out a hardness measurement by the Shore A procedure, comparable measurements shall be used for evaluation.
requirements.quote: Where it is impossible to carry out a hardness measurement by the Shore A procedure, comparable measurements shall be used for evaluation.

requirements.text: The provisions of paragraphs 5.1. to 5.5. shall apply to the front bumper in addition to the particular specifications of paragraph 6., except where these particular specifications expressly provide otherwise.
requirements.quote: The provisions of the above paragraphs 5.1. to 5.5. shall apply in addition to the particular specifications of the following paragraph 6., except where these particular specifications expressly provide otherwise.

requirements.text: Added ornaments which project more than 10 mm from their support shall retract, become detached or bend over under a force of 10 daN exerted at their most salient point in any direction in a plane approximately parallel to the surface on which they are mounted, except that these provisions shall not apply to ornaments on radiator grilles, to which only the general requirements of paragraph 5. shall apply.
requirements.quote: Added ornaments which project more than 10 mm from their support shall retract, become detached or bend over under a force of 10 daN exerted at their most salient point in any direction in a plane approximately parallel to the surface on which they are mounted. These provisions shall not apply to ornaments on radiator grilles, to which only the general requirements of paragraph 5. shall apply.

requirements.text: To apply the 10 daN force, a flat-ended ram of not more than 50 mm diameter shall be used, except that where this is not possible, an equivalent method shall be used.
requirements.quote: To apply the 10 daN force a flat-ended ram of not more than 50 mm diameter shall be used. Where this is not possible, an equivalent method shall be used.

requirements.text: After the ornaments are retracted, detached or bent over, the remaining projections shall not project more than 10 mm.
requirements.quote: After the ornaments are retracted, detached or bent over, the remaining projections shall not project more than 10 mm.

requirements.text: After the ornaments are retracted, detached or bent over, the remaining projections shall in any case satisfy the provisions of paragraph 5.2.
requirements.quote: These projections shall in any case satisfy the provisions of paragraph 5.2.

requirements.text: If the vehicle type submitted for approval pursuant to this Regulation meets the requirements of paragraphs 5. and 6. below, approval of that vehicle type shall be granted.
requirements.quote: If the vehicle type submitted for approval pursuant to this Regulation meets the requirements of paragraphs 5. and 6. below, approval of that vehicle type shall be granted.

requirements.text: Projecting visors and rims on the headlights shall have a projection, as measured in relation to the external transparent surface of the headlight, that does not exceed 30 mm.
requirements.quote: Projecting visors and rims shall be permitted on headlights, provided that their projection, as measured in relation to the external transparent surface of the headlight does not exceed 30 mm and their radius of curvature is at least 2.5 mm throughout.

requirements.text: Projecting visors and rims on the headlights shall have a radius of curvature of at least 2.5 mm throughout.
requirements.quote: Projecting visors and rims shall be permitted on headlights, provided that their projection, as measured in relation to the external transparent surface of the headlight does not exceed 30 mm and their radius of curvature is at least 2.5 mm throughout.

requirements.text: In the case of a headlamp mounted behind an additional transparent surface, the projection of the visors and rims shall be measured from the outermost transparent surface.
requirements.quote: In the case of a headlamp mounted behind an additional transparent surface, the projection shall be measured from the outermost transparent surface.

requirements.text: The projections of the headlight visors and rims shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 3. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The projections shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 3. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. shall not apply to gaps between fixed or movable elements, including those forming part of air intake or outlet grilles and radiator grilles, only if the distance between consecutive elements does not exceed 40 mm.
requirements.quote: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. above shall not apply to gaps between fixed or movable elements, including those forming part of air intake or outlet grilles and radiator grilles, provided that the distance between consecutive elements does not exceed 40 mm and provided that the grilles and gaps have a functional purpose.

requirements.text: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. shall not apply to gaps between fixed or movable elements, including those forming part of air intake or outlet grilles and radiator grilles, only if the grilles and gaps have a functional purpose.
requirements.quote: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. above shall not apply to gaps between fixed or movable elements, including those forming part of air intake or outlet grilles and radiator grilles, provided that the distance between consecutive elements does not exceed 40 mm and provided that the grilles and gaps have a functional purpose.

requirements.text: For gaps of between 40 mm and 25 mm, the radii of curvature of the grille and gap elements shall be 1 mm or more.
requirements.quote: For gaps of between 40 mm and 25 mm the radii of curvature shall be 1 mm or more.

requirements.text: If the distance between two consecutive elements is equal to or less than 25 mm, the radii of curvature of external faces of the grille and gap elements shall not be less than 0.5 mm.
requirements.quote: However, if the distance between two consecutive elements is equal to or less than 25 mm, the radii of curvature of external faces of the elements shall not be less than 0.5 mm.

requirements.text: The distance between two consecutive elements of grilles and gaps shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 4. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The distance between two consecutive elements of grilles and gaps shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 4. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: The junction of the front with the side faces of each element forming a grille or gap shall be blunted.
requirements.quote: The junction of the front with the side faces of each element forming a grille or gap shall be blunted.

requirements.text: The ends of the bumpers shall be turned in towards the external surface in order to minimize the risk of fouling.
requirements.quote: The ends of the bumpers shall be turned in towards the external surface in order to minimize the risk of fouling.

requirements.text: If the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward.
requirements.quote: If the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward, and a minimum radius of curvature of 2.5 mm in all other cases.

requirements.text: If the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 2.5 mm in all other cases.
requirements.quote: If the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward, and a minimum radius of curvature of 2.5 mm in all other cases.

requirements.text: The outward facing angles of parts on or of the bumper or of bumper insets which have a projection of less than 5 mm, with special reference to joint covers and jets for headlamp washers, shall be blunted, except where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
requirements.quote: The requirement of paragraph 6.5.2. above shall not apply to parts on or of the bumper or to bumper insets which have a projection of less than 5 mm, with special reference to joint covers and jets for headlamp washers; but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.

requirements.text: The provisions of paragraph 5. of this Regulation shall remain applicable to the bumper cover.
requirements.quote: The provisions of paragraph 5. of this Regulation remain applicable.

requirements.text: If supporting brackets provided by the vehicle manufacturer for registration plates are contactable by a 100 mm diameter sphere when a registration plate is fitted in accordance with the vehicle manufacturer's recommendation, the supporting brackets shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 5.4. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: Supporting brackets provided by the vehicle manufacturer for registration plates shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 5.4. of this Regulation if they are contactable by a 100 mm diameter sphere when a registration plate is fitted in accordance with the vehicle manufacturer's recommendation.

requirements.text: The height H of a projection of a fold in a body panel shall be determined graphically by reference to the circumference of a 165 mm diameter circle, internally tangential to the external outline of the external surface at the section to be checked.
requirements.quote: The height H of a projection is determined graphically by reference to the circumference of a 165 mm diameter circle, internally tangential to the external outline of the external surface at the section to be checked.

requirements.text: The height H of a projection of a fold in a body panel shall be the maximum value of the distance, measured along a straight line passing through the centre of the 165 mm diameter circle between the circumference of the aforesaid circle and the external contour of the projection (see Fig.1).
requirements.quote: H is the maximum value of the distance, measured along a straight line passing through the centre of the 165 mm diameter circle between the circumference of the aforesaid circle and the external contour of the projection (see Fig.1).
